headline: Trusted numbers first, then action before Go Big
annotation: Every segment and list ships with a holdout to prove impact.
source: Source: case study brief (Nov 2026); P&I proposal.
notes: Here is my answer: five priorities in three moves, and each one answers a finding we just saw.

Clarity. P1, one metric truth, because today we have targets for SoW and NPS but no baseline; it needs Finance and all squads to agree on definitions. P2, because part of the 22.6 thousand drops is balance noise; we give the concept council the evidence, they decide on the rules.
Learn. P3, because the rollout gets half of what the pilot did; with the pilot owners we find out why, by December, so it shapes Go Big.

Equip. P4, because Go Big needs targets: segments and triggers delivered through Digital Growth and Engagement's campaigns. P5, because every drop costs a client their savings rate: a weekly list for bankers, through squad Bankéř and the branches.
Everything is ready before Go Big, and every segment and list carries a holdout group, so we prove impact from day one.
